This is a game of Werewolf with 5 players: 1 Seer, 1 Werewolf, 1 Possessed, and 2 Villagers. Participants: Toshio, George, Sakura, Victoria and Kenji. Each player's role is secret.

- Werewolf: attacks one player each night from day 1 on.
- Possessed: a human who sides with the werewolf and wins when the werewolf wins; divination shows the Possessed as human.
- Villager: a human with no special ability.

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in days. Each day has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Kenji, Victoria, Toshio, George and Sakura. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this day). | 1 | the Seer is told the result of the night-0 divination (the Seer only) | 4 turns | every living player votes; the player with the most votes is executed | the Seer divines one other living player; the Werewolf attacks one other living player |
